name: Fiery Menace!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.

Me gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.

So, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.

I guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.
narrative.objectives:
Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.

Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Hansel sneezes.>

I think I'm gettin' a cold. Damn this frigid climate!
narrative.requestItemsText: Was he right? Does it come out their rumps?
